title: רב חנן בר אבא

paragraphs: Rav Chanan bar Abba, Rav's son-in-law. Gid HaNasheh, Chullin 95b: Rav was going to the house of Rav Chanan, his son-in-law, etc. It does not mention bar Abba, only the unqualified Chanan. But Ein Yaakov reads “Rav Chanan bar Rava, his son-in-law,” and this is the true reading; see immediately below. He was Rav Chisda's father-in-law; Yuchasin likewise writes this under R. Yehudah Nesia, whom he eulogized. See Rav Chanan bar Rava immediately below, where Yuchasin erred. He was Rav's student; so too Sheerit Yosef writes. “Rav said”—Bava Batra 25a. When Ravin came, “Rav Chanan bar Abba reported in Rav’s name”—Shabbat 112b. Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Tefillat HaShachar, has Chanan bar Abaye; Chanan bar Va disagrees, saying, “I saw what Rav did.” “Teacher of Chiyya bar Rav”—this is not so; see below. Rav Chana bar Abba, R. Yochanan, and R. Yonatan: Jerusalem Talmud, Bameh Tomnin. R. Yirmeyah bar Abba and Rav Yehudah were in the house of R. Avin of Nashkaya.
